speaker: Ms Ng Ling Ling
text: asked the Prime Minister in each of the past three years, what is the proportion of annual births from women who are (i) 30 years old and below (ii) between 31 and 35 years old and (iii) 36 years old and above, respectively.

speaker: Ms Ng Ling Ling (Ang Mo Kio)
text: Speaker, I thank the Minister for the reply.

speaker: Ms Ng Ling Ling (Ang Mo Kio)
text: I am referring to the higher proportion of women who are giving birth between the ages of 31 and 35.

speaker: Ms Ng Ling Ling (Ang Mo Kio)
text: From my conversations with some of these women, they are not aware that their fertility health get challenged during that period and sometimes there can be complications.

speaker: Ms Ng Ling Ling (Ang Mo Kio)
text: So, I wanted to ask one supplementary question.

speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
text: We have to see what we can do to encourage it and make it easier for people to get married and have children.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Mr Louis Ng, with regard to your Question No 10, I will get the Ministry to give you a written reply.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The Clerk will now proceed to read the Orders of the day.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: [Pursuant to Standing Order No 22(3), provided that Members had not asked for questions standing in their names to be postponed to a later Sitting day or withdrawn, written answers to questions not reached by the end of Question Time are reproduced in the Appendix.]
